_comment: Antigravity CLI (.agents/mcp_config.json), which supports 'cwd' natively so no sh -c wrapper is needed. Copy into the repo you want to USE the server from and replace the two ALL-CAPS placeholders. MCP_CLONE is where you cloned local_hex_mcp; YOUR_PROJECT is the repo you are editing. DATABASE_PATH is deliberately absent: it defaults to <MCP_CLONE>/priv/mcp.db, which is also what 'mix setup' migrates.
